data.title: iPhone owners could get up to $95 from a new Apple settlement
data.body: A proposed $250 million settlement would compensate millions of consumers who bought the iPhone 16, the iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max.

data.title: Apple class action settlement could pay you money. See who's eligible
data.body: If you purchased an iPhone between June 10, 2024 and March 29, 2025, you could be eligible for money from a class action settlement with Apple.

data.title: Apple to pay $250M to settle lawsuit over Siri’s delayed AI features
data.body: Apple has agreed to pay $250 million to settle a class action lawsuit for overpromising the arrival of Siri's AI features.
